title: Spot Urine Collection Protocol
author: Jeff Hodgin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56fg9bn

steps.title: Prepare Metabolic Cages
steps.instruction: Construct and sterilize the metabolic cages for lean and obese mice.

substeps.instruction: Drill 6 evenly spaced holes in the container lid (3 on top, 3 at bottom) using a 1/8” drill bit.
Drill 2 holes on each of the four sides of the container.
Cut a 14.5 cm by 9.5 cm piece of stainless steel wire mesh using a metal cutter.
Bend all four sides of the wire mesh using a flyer to create 1 cm perpendicular bends on each side.
Insert the wire mesh base into the container with bends pointing downward, ensuring a snug fit approximately 1” above the bottom.
Repeat the process for the obese mouse cage.
Wash and autoclave the wire mesh before use.

steps.title: Acclimatize Mice
steps.instruction: Acclimatize the mice to the metabolic cages prior to collection.

substeps.instruction: Place mice in the metabolic cages for 30 to 60 minutes every day for 3 consecutive days.

steps.title: Prepare Collection Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and labeling for urine collection.

substeps.instruction: Label urine collecting tubes with identification numbers for each animal.
Place cages in an operational laminar flood hood to maintain SPF housing.

steps.title: Initiate Urine Collection
steps.instruction: Place mice in cages and set up identification cards.

substeps.instruction: Place one mouse per box in the metabolic cage and secure the lid.
Label the top of the box with the mouse number.
Place a cage card in front of the metabolic cage containing: mouse ID, protocol number, emergency contact, PI name, date, 4-hour collection time period, and a 'DO NOT FEED' sticker.

steps.title: Monitor Collection Period
steps.instruction: Collect urine over a 4-hour period without food or water access.

substeps.instruction: Ensure an exception is completed for the 4-hour deprivation of food and water.
Check mice every hour to monitor health conditions.

steps.title: Harvest and Process Urine
steps.instruction: Remove mice and process the collected urine samples.

substeps.instruction: After 4 hours, remove the mouse from the metabolic cage and return it to its original housing cage.
Carefully collect urine using a pipette (P200 recommended) and place it into a 1.5 mL micro centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the urine at 2000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and transfer it to a clean 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Store Samples
steps.instruction: Store the processed urine samples based on the required timeframe.

substeps.instruction: Store at 4ºC for short-term use.
Store at -20ºC or -80ºC for long-term use.

steps.title: Clean and Disinfect Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean the metabolic cages and components.

substeps.instruction: Wash acrylic parts with hot, soapy water.
Spray all cage parts with a bactericidal, virucidal, and fungicidal disinfectant (e.g., Clidox® or Spor-Klenz®) and wipe down.
Dry each part and reassemble.
